mentions.name: ReceiptBin
mentions.description: Plenty of existing receipt-tracking apps feel out of place on iOS and lock basic features like OCR and autofill behind paywalls.
mentions.problem: I built ReceiptBin because I wanted a simple way to track receipts and link them to my budgeting app.
mentions.audience: This app tracks receipts and links them to a budgeting app, using Apple's VisionKit and Foundation Models for OCR and autofill at no cost. Receipts sync through iCloud, reports are generated entirely on-device, and the app supports widgets and Siri Shortcuts. The author plans a further update with bug fixes and new functionality.
